exposure: prenatal risk factors (e.g., maternal diabetes, hypertension)
postnatal complications (e.g., respiratory distress syndrome, sepsis)
cohort: Infants admitted to a tertiary care hospital with a gestational age <= 32 weeks and birth weight <= 1500 grams.
finding: The study found that ROP occurred in 100% of the at-risk infants included in the study.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (64.3%).
